fixes.was: a consumer's unilateral act of taking a product into the forum, and the mere foreseeability that it might travel there, do not suffice.
fixes.now: a consumer's post-sale travel with the product into the forum does not supply it, and the relevant foreseeability is anticipating suit from the defendant's own conduct.

fixes.was: A contract with a forum resident is only the starting fact.
fixes.now: A contract with a forum resident is the starting fact.

fixes.was: and on May 21, 2019, that court accepted review and upheld jurisdiction
fixes.now: which accepted supervisory control and, on May 21, 2019, upheld jurisdiction

fixes.was: All assertions of state-court jurisdiction, including in rem and quasi in rem jurisdiction over property, must be evaluated under the minimum-contacts standards of International Shoe and its progeny.
fixes.now: Assertions of state-court jurisdiction over property, whether labeled in rem or quasi in rem, must be evaluated under International Shoe and its progeny; the mere statutory presence of property unrelated to the claim does not supply sufficient contacts.
